corrections.text: The article states Qwen's model card 'shows Qwen3.8-27B improving on its predecessors across all four tests, outscoring both Qwen3.6-27B and the closed-weight Qwen3.7-Plus.' Qwen3.8-27B does lead Qwen3.7-Plus on three of the four published benchmarks, but on GPQA Diamond the model card actually lists Qwen3.7-Plus at 90.3, ahead of Qwen3.8-27B's 89.2.
